title: Book Three · Chapter 55: Inside the Hall
story:
The first school week ends. On Saturday, Ronan meets Anna outside the hall at ten.

She has the notebook with the summer drawings. He has a pencil and two clean sheets.

A man is opening the inner doors. Anna goes up to him.

“May we look at the entrance from inside?” she asks. “We want to draw it.”

The man looks at their notebooks.

“You can sit by the side wall. People will bring chairs through the middle.”

“Thank you.”

They go in together. From inside, the wide window looks higher. Light falls onto the first step, then spreads across the floor.

Anna stands still for a moment. She looks from the window to the doorway.

From here, she can see how high the window begins above the door. She marks the lower edge with her pencil.

“Different?” Ronan asks.

“Very.”

They sit on two chairs beside the wall. Anna starts with the door. Ronan draws the step below it.

From his chair, one side of the step looks shorter than the other. He looks up, then down at his paper.

“The building won't stay straight.”

Anna leans closer to see.

“Your chair isn't in the middle.”

“The building should know that.”

She laughs and shows him her own first lines. They do not look like the drawing from outside either.

Two women carry chairs past them. One walks backward for a few steps. The other tells her about the edge of the floor.

Ronan moves his feet in. Anna pulls her bag against the wall.

For a while, they draw quietly. Ronan can hear the chairs touch the floor at the far end.

Then he notices a bright patch on Anna's page. It has moved from one corner to the middle.

“The light moved.”

Anna looks up. A cloud has passed. The window is bright again.

She puts down her pencil and watches the floor. Ronan waits beside her.

“I want another look on a wet day,” she says. “Not just a grey one.”

“More work for the window.”

“For me.”

They finish the two drawings and thank the man at the door. Anna shows him her page. He recognises the entrance at once.

Ronan keeps his sheet behind hers.

“Yours too?” the man asks.

Ronan holds it out. The step is wide at one end and narrow at the other.

“You sat near the side,” the man says.

Ronan looks at Anna. “The building told him.”

She laughs all the way to the low wall outside.

They put the drawings side by side. Anna's is neater, but both show the doorway from inside.

Ronan adds the date at the bottom of his sheet. Then he puts it in his notebook and closes the cover over the fresh pencil lines.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

inner＝里面的；side wall＝侧墙；patch＝一小片区域；recognise＝认出。

## 理解问题

1. 两人有没有兑现新学期第一周后到会堂询问的约定？他们坐在哪里观察？
2. Ronan看到的台阶两边为什么不一样长？室内的光线又发生了什么变化？

## 读句子

**Anna pulls her bag against the wall.**

拆开看：Anna / pulls her bag / against the wall.

Anna／把包拉过来／拉到紧靠墙的位置。
